job.job_description:
Global Healthcare Billing Partners Pvt. Ltd

Job Title: Lead AI Engineer
Location: Chennai (Work from Office)
Experience: 8+ Years

About Company

Global Healthcare Billing Partners Pvt. Ltd (India) and Global Healthcare Resource (USA) is a leading provider of healthcare RCM and outsourcing solutions. With delivery centers in Chennai, Atlanta, and Chicago, we deliver high-quality services across medical billing, coding, and patient engagement. Our onsite-offshore model helps clients reduce costs while improving efficiency and quality.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Lead AI Engineer to drive the design, architecture, and delivery of enterprise-scale AI and Generative AI solutions. The candidate will lead AI initiatives, mentor teams, and build scalable AI platforms leveraging LLMs, Agentic AI, MLOps, and cloud technologies.

Key Responsibilities

AI Solution Leadership

Lead end-to-end delivery of AI/ML and Generative AI programs
Define AI architecture, strategies, and best practices
Convert business requirements into scalable AI solutions

Generative AI & Agentic AI

Design solutions using LLMs, RAG frameworks
Build Agentic AI / Multi-Agent Systems
Develop reusable AI frameworks and accelerators

Architecture & Platform Engineering

Architect AI platforms using Azure AI, Vertex AI, Databricks, MLOps
Define governance, monitoring, and Responsible AI standards
Ensure scalability and cloud optimization

Client & Business Engagement

Participate in solutioning, RFPs, and proposals
Conduct client workshops and technical discussions
Identify AI-driven transformation opportunities

Leadership & Team Management

Mentor AI engineers and data scientists
Drive technical reviews and engineering standards
Support hiring and capability development

Required Skills

LLMs, RAG, Agentic AI, Multi-Agent Systems
LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen
Python, PyTorch, TensorFlow
MLflow, Databricks, MLOps
Azure OpenAI, GCP Vertex AI, AWS AI Services
Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD

Leadership Competencies

Solution Architecture
Stakeholder Management
Technical Leadership
Team Mentoring
Pre-Sales & Proposal Support

Qualifications & Experience

Bachelors / Masters in Computer Science / AI / Data Science
8+ years in AI/ML with strong exposure to Generative AI & LLMs
Experience in enterprise AI solution delivery and architecture
Relevant certifications (Azure AI / AWS / GCP / Databricks) preferred

Mandatory Practical Experience

Prompt engineering & evaluation
RAG pipeline implementation
Vector database integration
LLM output validation & accuracy testing
Monitoring, logging, and cost optimization
Responsible AI & data privacy practices
